DEVELOPMENT  PLAN  REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  June 24, 2025 AT 8: 30 AM
  245 EAST BONITA AVENUE
  COUNCIL  CHAMBER  CONFERENCE  ROOM

  If

  David Bratt, Planning Commission
  Scott Dilley, Chamber of Commerce
  Brad McKinney, City Manager
  Steve Barrigan,  Public Works Supervisor ( substitute  for Shari Garwick)
  Luis Torrico, Director of Community Development

  Anne Moore, Senior Planner
  Taylor Galindo, Assistant Planner
  Caitlyn Cortez, Administrative  Assistant

CALL TO ORDER

David Bratt called the regular meeting of the Developmental Plan Review Board to order at 8: 35
a. m. so as to conduct regular business in the Council Chamber Conference Room.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  1.  May 22, 2025 Minutes

Moved by City Manager McKinney, seconded by Mr. Dilley to approve the May 22, 2025
Development Plan Review Board minutes. Motion carried 5- 0.

DPRB ITEMS

DPRB 1. DPRB 24- 02; PROJ 24- 08

A request to approve the exterior modification of a two- story building listed on the Historic
Resource Survey List, located at 213 W Bonita Avenue within Town Core. ( APN: 83877014- 030)

Assistant Planner Galindo presented the staff report and recommended the Board approve
DPRB 24- 02; PROJ 24- 08.

Director of Community Development Torrico stated we received a letter form a resident that
raised concerns about the material being proposed for the existing building. The main concern is
the property is on the Historic resource list which was made in 1991, the resident is asking we
work with an architectural historian to identify the appropriate material to use. The issue is that
while the City does have a historic resources inventory list, it is just a survey that was done in the
90' s to identify properties that could potentially be considered eligible for nomination at the state
 DPRB Minutes
June 24, 2025  Page 2

or federal level. The typical steps taken after that is the City adopts a local ordinance which
establishes criteria that allows the City to designate them as historic and these steps were never
taken. In the past, these projects went to DPRB and staff works with the applicant to pick materials
that don' t take away from the architectural features of the property and do not impact the overall
esthetic and character of the building. Staff have not applied the sector interior standards because
they are not technically designated a historical property, but they typically work with the applicant
to find materials to keep the overall character of town core.

Mr. Bratt asked if under the ADA requirements, do they have to put in an elevator to the second
floor.

Assistant Planner Galindo stated we would address that in plan check and confirm with Building

Director of Community Development Torrico stated that his understanding is if the building is
existing it wouldn' t be required but we will certainly confirm in the plan check process.

Mr. Bratt stated he was just asking because of the senior property next door that required an
elevator.

Director of Community Development Torrico stated that if it' s new construction and new use
then an elevator would be required, but because the building is existing his understanding is it
won' t be required by code.

The Applicant stated that their goal is to make the building better than it is currently.

Mr. Bratt asked if the applicant is okay with the added conditions on the windows.

The Applicant stated yes, they discussed the windows with Taylor and Marco.

Senior Planner Moore asked if the Board was okay with staff working with the applicant on the
paint colors.

Mr. Bratt stated yes, the Board is okay with staff working on the colors.

Assistant Planner Galindo confirmed there is a condition  that discusses  all colors must be
submitted to the Planning Division for review. Condition No. 30.

Motion: DPRB 24- 16

Mr. Dilley moved to recommend approval of DPRB 24- 02, subject to the conditions of approval
outlined in attachment 1.

Motion seconded by Public Works Supervisor Barragan.

Motion carried 5- 0.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
 DPRB Minutes
June 24, 2025  Page 3

No communications  were made.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business the meeting was adjourned at 8: 51 a. m. to the meeting of July
10, 2025.

  David Bratt, Chairman
  Development Plan Review Board
